In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the $hep$ reaction is the most robust and accurate process to determine the solar neutrino fluxes.
the ChPT approach is a reliable and efficient tool to calculate nuclear matrix elements of the $hep$ transition.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, by combining SNPA and EFT, we can achieve a precision in the $S$-factor that is comparable with the precision in the nuclear matrix elements, but without the use of nuclear structure data.
we have obtained a very accurate estimate of the nuclear part of the solar $hepprocess$, which is the dominant uncertainty in the calculation of the solar neutrino fluxes.
, by using the nuclear wave functions of SNPA and the transition operators of ChPT, we have achieved an accuracy of \nlo3 for the $S$-factor of $hep$ in the solar plasma.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nuclear matrix elements are the dominant source of uncertainty in the $S$-factor.
ChPT provides a reliable and systematic tool for the calculation of low-energy nuclear processes, such as solar fusion, that are sensitive to the short-range nuclear dynamics.
the uncertainty of the theoretical prediction is now dominated by nuclear uncertainties and not by chiral uncertainties, as in previous studies.
